guidance: Intentional architecture reduces attack vectors and blast radius. Key principles: replace exposed SSH/RDP with AWS Systems Manager Fleet Manager; restrict Security Groups to minimum required paths (e.g., databases accept traffic only from the app server Security Group); deploy across multiple AZs. Use the AWS Well-Architected Framework and AWS Security Reference Architecture as design guides. Use Workload Discovery on AWS to auto-generate architecture diagrams and detect shadow IT.
how_to_check: Have network paths, Security Group rules, and AZ distribution been deliberately planned? Are admin ports eliminated in favor of SSM Fleet Manager? Has the team reviewed the AWS Well-Architected Framework security pillar and Security Reference Architecture? Has Workload Discovery been used to identify undocumented resources? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
